definition: Johanna Doris Moore is a computational linguist and cognitive scientist.
details: Her research publications include contributions to natural language generation, spoken dialogue systems, computational models of discourse, intelligent tutoring and training systems, human-computer interaction, user modeling, and knowledge representation.

explainer.lead: Johanna Moore is a Computer scientist.

timeline.what: Moore has held posts at UCLA (1976–1986), USC Information Sciences Institute (1983–1989), and the University of Pittsburgh (1990–1998).
She received a BS in Mathematics and Computer Science (summa cum laude) in 1980, an MS in Computer Science in 1982, and PhD (Advisors: William Swartout, Gerald Estrin) in 1989, all from UCLA.
From June 2015 to May 2016, Moore carried out a research project on Connected Digital Economy.
